title: Offenses, Faith, and the Coming Kingdom

questions.question: Jesus said to His disciples: "Temptations to sin are sure to come, but..."?
options: "...woe to the one through whom they come!"
"...blessed are those who resist them completely."
"...great is your reward if you flee them fast."
"...woe to those who stay in the cities where they multiply."
questions.correctAnswer: "...woe to the one through whom they come!"
questions.explanation: Luke 17:1 (ESV): "And he said to his disciples, 'Temptations to sin are sure to come, but woe to the one through whom they come!'"

questions.question: Jesus said it would be better for a person to be thrown into the sea with a millstone tied around his neck than to do what?
options: Cause one of these little ones to sin
Deny the name of the Son of Man
Steal a single coin from the temple treasury
Refuse to wash the feet of a thirsty traveler
questions.correctAnswer: Cause one of these little ones to sin
questions.explanation: Luke 17:2 (ESV): "It would be better for him if a millstone were hung around his neck and he were cast into the sea than that he should cause one of these little ones to sin."

questions.question: If your brother sins against you seven times in the day, and turns to you seven times, saying, "I repent," what must you do?
options: You must forgive him
Turn your back and listen no longer
Bring him before the elders of the city
Forgive him only three times, then judge him
questions.explanation: Luke 17:4 (ESV): "and if he sins against you seven times in the day, and turns to you seven times, saying, 'I repent,' you must forgive him."

questions.question: When the apostles said to the Lord, "Increase our faith!", Jesus said: "If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you could say to this..."?
options: Mulberry tree, "Be uprooted and planted in the sea," and it would obey you
Mountain, "Be cast into the sea," and it would jump instantly
Blind man, "Open your eyes," and he would see clearly
Den of thieves, "Be destroyed completely," and fire would fall
questions.correctAnswer: Mulberry tree, "Be uprooted and planted in the sea," and it would obey you
questions.explanation: Luke 17:6 (ESV): "And the Lord said, 'If you had faith like a grain of mustard seed, you could say to this mulberry tree, "Be uprooted and planted in the sea," and it would obey you.'"

questions.question: In the parable of the unworthy servant, when you have done all that you were commanded, what should you say?
options: "We are unworthy servants; we have only done what was our duty."
"We have earned the grandest rest the Lord can give."
"We wait for our wages before the sun goes down."
"Now serve us, for our hands are bruised from labor."
questions.correctAnswer: "We are unworthy servants; we have only done what was our duty."
questions.explanation: Luke 17:10 (ESV): "So you also, when you have done all that you were commanded, say, 'We are unworthy servants; we have only done what was our duty.'"

questions.question: As Jesus entered a village on His way to Jerusalem, who met Him, standing at a distance?
options: Ten lepers
Five blind beggars
Four possessed men
Twelve tax collectors
questions.explanation: Luke 17:12 (ESV): "And as he entered a village, he was met by ten lepers, who stood at a distance"

questions.question: The ten lepers lifted up their voices and called out, "Jesus, Master, have mercy on us." What did Jesus tell them to do?
options: "Go and show yourselves to the priests."
"Go wash in the Jordan River seven times."
"Go back to your homes in peace."
"Come near and I will touch your skin."
questions.correctAnswer: "Go and show yourselves to the priests."
questions.explanation: Luke 17:14 (ESV): "When he saw them he said to them, 'Go and show yourselves to the priests.' And as they went they were cleansed."

questions.question: When the ten lepers were cleansed as they went, how many turned back to praise God with a loud voice and fall at Jesus' feet?
options: Only one (and he was a Samaritan)
Three of them, from Galilee
All ten of them returned joyfully
None returned, fearing the priests
questions.correctAnswer: Only one (and he was a Samaritan)
questions.explanation: Luke 17:15-16 (ESV): "Then one of them, when he saw that he was healed, turned back, praising God with a loud voice; and he fell on his face at Jesus' feet, giving him thanks. Now he was a Samaritan."

questions.question: What question did Jesus ask when only the Samaritan returned?
options: "Were not ten cleansed? Where are the nine?"
"Why did the Jews fail to see the miracle?"
"Has your leprosy truly left you completely?"
"Do you wish to follow me to Jerusalem now?"
questions.correctAnswer: "Were not ten cleansed? Where are the nine?"
questions.explanation: Luke 17:17 (ESV): "Then Jesus answered, 'Were not ten cleansed? Where are the nine?'"

questions.question: Being asked by the Pharisees when the kingdom of God would come, Jesus answered: "The kingdom of God is not coming in ways that can be observed." Where did He say it is?
options: "For behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you." (or "within you")
"It rests quietly on the holy mountain of Zion."
"It descends first in the desert places."
"It waits silently beyond the clouds."
questions.correctAnswer: "For behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you." (or "within you")
questions.explanation: Luke 17:21 (ESV): "...nor will they say, 'Look, here it is!' or 'There!' for behold, the kingdom of God is in the midst of you."

questions.question: Jesus told the disciples that days are coming when they will desire to see one of the days of the Son of Man, but they will not see it. If people say, "Look, there!" or "Look, here!", what should the disciples do?
options: Do not go out or follow them
Follow them cautiously at a distance
Investigate immediately with a sword
Shout from the rooftops that it is a lie
questions.correctAnswer: Do not go out or follow them
questions.explanation: Luke 17:23 (ESV): "And they will say to you, 'Look, there!' or 'Look, here!' Do not go out or follow them."

questions.question: Jesus compares the day when the Son of Man is revealed to two specific historical periods. What were the people doing in the days of Noah right up until Noah entered the ark?
options: They were eating and drinking and marrying and being given in marriage, until the flood came and destroyed them all
They were building tall towers attempting to reach the gates of heaven
They were sacrificing to foreign gods constantly
They were warring against the righteous few endlessly
questions.correctAnswer: They were eating and drinking and marrying and being given in marriage, until the flood came and destroyed them all
questions.explanation: Luke 17:27 (ESV): "They were eating and drinking and marrying and being given in marriage, until the day when Noah entered the ark, and the flood came and destroyed them all."

questions.question: What happened on the day that Lot went out from Sodom?
options: Fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all
A great earthquake swallowed the entire city whole
A devastating plague wiped entirely the wicked away
The sea rose and drowned the valley instantly
questions.correctAnswer: Fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all
questions.explanation: Luke 17:29 (ESV): "but on the day when Lot went out from Sodom, fire and sulfur rained from heaven and destroyed them all—"

questions.question: Jesus warns: "On that day, let the one who is on the housetop, with his goods in the house, not come down to take them away..." Whom did He command the disciples to remember?
options: Remember Lot's wife
Remember Noah's sons
Remember Abraham's faith
Remember Moses' haste

questions.question: The disciples asked, "Where, Lord?" concerning the sudden events of the Son of Man. Jesus quoted a proverb: "Where the corpse is..."?
options: "...there the vultures will gather."
"...there the grave is dug deeply."
"...there the silence is completely absolute."
"...there the lions seek their prey."
questions.explanation: Luke 17:37 (ESV): "And they said to him, 'Where, Lord?' He said to them, 'Where the corpse is, there the vultures will gather.'"

key_verse_text: "Whoever seeks to preserve his life will lose it, but whoever loses his life will keep it."
